_meta.source_of_truth: This JSON is the MACHINE-readable canonical defect taxonomy. The narrative registry (DEFECT-REGISTRY.md, same directory) is the human-readable companion — edit BOTH when adding a class. Studio's inc/defect-taxonomy.php is GENERATED from this file by ../scripts/gen_defect_taxonomy.py — never hand-edit that include.

fields.id: stable canonical ID (never renumbered; retire via deprecated:true)
fields.slug: snake_case key used in every JSON payload (flags, defect-log events, gate verdict tags)
fields.label: human label shown in the Studio flag picker
fields.frequency: VH|H|M|L snapshot estimate 2026-07-18 — the Studio defect log supersedes this as data accumulates
fields.vision: live = the ck_ai_qa scanner detects it today; feasible = single-image detectable, not yet in the checklist; partial = adjacent scanner type catches some cases; no = needs refs/sequence/story context or human judgment
fields.ck_type: the LIVE scanner enum value that maps here (null if none)
fields.scanner_line: checklist sentence for ck_qa_checklist() — present for vision=live (current wording) and vision=feasible (proposed wording, Phase 2)
fields.prevention: short prompt-injectable prevention snippet for the fast loop (null when prevention is structural, not prompt-side)
fields.pick: show in the Studio owner flag picker (false for process-only classes with no panel to look at)

defects.label: Duplicate character (same person twice)
defects.scanner_line: DUPLICATE CHARACTER — the SAME character appears two or more times in one panel (a cloned / twinned figure). This is the #1 defect to catch.
defects.prevention: EXACTLY the named cast appears in frame — count the figures: if the panel names N characters, render exactly N human figures. Never render the same character twice; attached references describe ONE person each, not multiple people.

defects.label: Unwanted extra / background person
defects.scanner_line: UNWANTED EXTRA / BACKGROUND PERSON — any human in frame who is not one of the named cast (strangers, crowd, photo-bombers, blurred background people). The cast is fixed: only named characters may appear.
defects.prevention: The cast is CLOSED: only the named characters appear. Empty background — no bystanders, no crowd, no passers-by, no blurred background people, even in public locations.

defects.label: Wrong people count / missing character
defects.scanner_line: WRONG PEOPLE COUNT — more (or fewer) people than the panel's intended cast.
defects.prevention: This panel contains EXACTLY the listed characters — no more, no fewer. Count the human figures before compositing the scene.

defects.label: Identity / likeness drift
defects.prevention: Render the attached face reference exactly — do not reinterpret facial features from text. The face card overrides everything else on identity.

defects.label: Canonical/IP character off-model
defects.prevention: Render the canonical published version of this character exactly as fans recognize them — NOT a generic interpretation.

defects.label: Male-anatomy drift on female ECU
defects.scanner_line: MALE-BODY DRIFT — a body-region close-up of a muscular FEMALE character reads male: square male pectorals, flat-plane chest, no breast contour, masculine bone structure.
defects.prevention: The body is unambiguously FEMALE despite the hyper-developed muscle: feminine bone structure, visible breast contour, feminine waist taper, smaller hands and wrists. NOT a male body — no square male pectorals.

defects.label: Beauty regression (plain face)
defects.prevention: Vogue-cover face quality: sculpted cheekbones, refined jawline, expressive eyes with long natural lashes — strikingly beautiful, never a generic default-pretty AI face.

defects.label: Wardrobe drift / garment redesign
defects.scanner_line: WARDROBE DRIFT — a character's outfit or colour differs from the intended wardrobe, or changes mid-scene.
defects.prevention: The garment family is LOCKED: render the exact garment type shown in the attached wardrobe reference (same cut, same colours, same state). Do not improvise a different garment that loosely matches the description.

defects.label: Costume-damage regression (tears reset)
defects.prevention: Costume damage is CUMULATIVE: every tear and missing piece from the previous panel is still present, in the same place, plus any new damage. Damage never heals or relocates between panels.

defects.label: Emblem/insignia on wrong garment
defects.scanner_line: EMBLEM / INSIGNIA LEAK — a costume emblem, chevron, logo or insignia appears on a garment or character that should not carry it (check the wardrobe note for who wears what), or the emblem design is wrong.
defects.prevention: Emblems belong ONLY to the costume that owns them: no chevron, logo, or insignia on any other character's clothing or on civilian garments. Plain fabric everywhere the wardrobe note does not name an emblem.

defects.label: Coverage violation (always-clothed breach)
defects.scanner_line: COVERAGE VIOLATION — breasts, buttocks or groin coverage is lost. Garments may strain, stretch or tear at seams, but coverage of those regions must always be preserved.
defects.prevention: Garments may strain, stretch and tear at the seams, but coverage of chest, hips and groin stays fully intact in every panel.

defects.label: Tier under-render (size too small)
defects.prevention: OVER-SPEC COMPENSATION: the model normalizes extreme proportions DOWN toward average — render the muscle mass AND breast scale slightly LARGER than the attached tier reference shows, so the final result lands AT the reference's level, never below it.

defects.label: Size regression between panels
defects.prevention: Size is MONOTONIC: once a character reaches a muscle/breast/glute size they stay at that size or larger in every subsequent panel — never smaller.

defects.label: Wrong transformation stage for the beat
defects.scanner_line: WRONG TRANSFORMATION STAGE — the character is muscular / transformed when this beat should be soft / untransformed (or vice-versa).

defects.label: Invented state change (unasked tier bump)
defects.prevention: Render ONLY the transformation state the shotlist declares for this panel — no extra growth, no new damage, no hair change, no state invention beyond what is written.

defects.label: Malformed anatomy (limbs/hands/fusion)
defects.scanner_line: MALFORMED ANATOMY — extra or missing fingers / limbs, fused or distorted bodies, broken hands, melted faces.
defects.prevention: Anatomy coherence: exactly two arms and two legs per character, five fingers per hand, torso/hips/feet facing the same direction, all limbs attached naturally.

defects.label: FMG-anatomy style error
defects.prevention: FMG anatomy rules: hourglass figure preserved, round (not teardrop) breasts, pillowy (not blocky) abs, no drumstick forearms, head and hands stay small relative to the grown body.

defects.label: Height/scale inflation (accidental giantess)
defects.scanner_line: HEIGHT / SCALE ERROR — a character renders giant / towering (or doll-scale small) relative to the other characters and props, when only muscle mass should change.
defects.prevention: Height clamp: muscle mass and fullness grow per the attached tier reference — height changes ONLY per the tier lineup, never beyond it. NOT a giantess; same height relative to doors, furniture and other characters.

defects.label: Skin sheen/texture inconsistency
defects.prevention: Skin: natural healthy matte skin with subtle subsurface scattering — NOT oiled, NOT wet, NOT bodybuilder-competition shine, consistent with the neighbouring panels.

defects.label: Skin rendered as torn fabric
defects.scanner_line: SKIN TORN AS FABRIC — tear/rip/shred texture applied to SKIN instead of the garment. Garments may tear at seams; skin tearing is an instant fail.
defects.prevention: Only fabric tears — at seams, with visible torn cloth edges. Skin is never torn, ripped, or shredded.

defects.label: Growth plateaued across sequence
defects.prevention: Each growth rung must render visibly larger than its predecessor on at least one named axis; restate the delta explicitly per rung.

defects.label: Hair state drift (buns/ribbons/loose)
defects.scanner_line: HAIR DRIFT — hair style, accessories, or tied/loose state differs from the intended look (check the wardrobe / continuity note) or visibly changes mid-scene.

defects.label: Location reinvention / room drift
defects.prevention: Render the attached environment reference exactly — same architecture, same furniture, same materials. Do not reinvent the room from the prompt text.

defects.label: Void/grey studio background
defects.scanner_line: VOID BACKGROUND — the character floats against a grey / blurry / empty studio void instead of a real location background.

defects.label: Lighting/time-of-day drift
defects.prevention: Keep the scene's existing palette and time of day exactly — do not shift toward night, cool tones, or a different light source than the neighbouring panels.

defects.label: Anachronistic accessory (watch/jewelry)
defects.scanner_line: ANACHRONISTIC / HALLUCINATED PROP — watches, jewellery, phones or modern objects that do not belong.
defects.prevention: Accessories: ONLY the canonical accessories listed for this character. NO watches, NO bracelets, NO modern jewelry, no earrings, no necklaces, no rings.

defects.label: Reference rendered as scene object
defects.scanner_line: REFERENCE AS OBJECT — a reference sheet rendered as a literal in-scene object: an inset photo, badge, poster, grid lines, figure numbers, model-sheet panels, or floating annotation text.
defects.prevention: DO NOT render any reference image as a physical scene object — no inset photos, no watermarks, no figure numbers, no badges, no floating stats text. References guide identity and proportion only.

defects.label: Prompt literalization (metaphor rendered)
defects.scanner_line: LITERALIZED FIGURE OF SPEECH — an object in frame that contradicts the scene and looks like a metaphor rendered literally (e.g. an actual snake for a 'cobra back').

defects.label: Prop/object integrity glitch
defects.scanner_line: PROP GLITCH — physically incoherent object: a barbell bar that stops mid-air, floating or duplicated parts, equipment fused with a body, a held object that doesn't connect. Trace every load-bearing prop end to end.
defects.prevention: Every prop renders physically complete and coherent; held equipment connects continuously through the grip.

defects.label: Missing / empty lettering
defects.scanner_line: MISSING / EMPTY LETTERING — the panel context says a character speaks but there is no speech balloon, or a balloon / caption renders EMPTY with no text inside.

defects.label: Garbled text / text artifacts
defects.scanner_line: TEXT / LETTERING ARTIFACT — garbled gibberish text, stray tier labels or metadata baked into the art.

defects.label: Balloon tail points at wrong speaker
defects.scanner_line: WRONG BALLOON ATTRIBUTION — a speech balloon's tail points at a character who is not the speaker, or balloons from different speakers are merged.

defects.label: Watermark / branding baked into art
defects.scanner_line: WATERMARK/BRANDING — any rendered wordmark, logo, trademark, render-engine credit (e.g. 'RENDERED IN DAZ STUDIO'), or signature baked into the art that is not part of the lettering spec. Check corners and edges. Hard fail regardless of quality.
defects.prevention: No text, logos, watermarks, trademarks, or render-engine credits anywhere in the image except the specified lettering.

defects.label: SFX crowding or missing
defects.scanner_line: SFX MISUSE — sound-effect lettering covers a face or the panel's key body region, or dominates the frame; or an impact/growth beat that specifies SFX shows none.
defects.prevention: SFX exactly as specified, placed clear of faces and the key body region, occupying a small fraction of the frame.

defects.label: Lettering style inconsistent (odd bubble)
defects.scanner_line: LETTERING STYLE DRIFT — a speech bubble whose fill color, outline, or font differs from the project's uniform bubble style (e.g. one blue bubble among white ones).
defects.prevention: All speech balloons share one uniform style: white fill, black outline, same font, unless the spec says otherwise.

defects.label: Dead face on an emotional beat
defects.scanner_line: WOODEN / NEUTRAL FACE ON AN EMOTIONAL BEAT — a flat, dead, expressionless face when the beat calls for emotion (talking, strain, shock, effort, fear).
defects.prevention: The face registers PEAK intensity matched to the beat — strain, ecstasy, awe, shock, triumphant exertion. NEVER neutral, calm, slack or blank on an emotional or growth beat.

defects.label: Uniform expressions / wrong gaze
defects.scanner_line: EXPRESSION UNIFORMITY / WRONG GAZE — multiple characters wear identical expressions, stare at the camera, or bystanders stay neutral during something extraordinary.
defects.prevention: Each character carries a DISTINCT emotional beat; characters look at each other or at the action, never at the camera; bystanders visibly react to the extraordinary.

defects.label: Camera too far for the beat
defects.scanner_line: CAMERA TOO FAR — the panel's intended framing is a close-up or body-region shot but the render is materially wider (full body when an ECU was intended).
defects.prevention: EXTREME CLOSE-UP on the changing body region filling 70%+ of the frame — head and feet cropped OUT. This is a body-region ECU, NOT a full-body shot.

defects.label: Flat subject staging (yearbook lineup)
defects.scanner_line: FLAT STAGING — multiple figures stand parallel to the camera plane at equal scale and depth, like a yearbook photo, with no diagonal, depth layering, or scale contrast.
defects.prevention: Break the camera plane: stage the subjects on a diagonal with real Z-depth — lead character foreground-dominant, others at visibly different scales and depths. Never a flat side-by-side lineup facing the camera.

defects.label: Declared camera/angle disobeyed
defects.scanner_line: CAMERA DISOBEYED — the panel's intended camera angle (from the plan context) was ignored: characters render front-facing / static when the spec says profile, low-angle, over-shoulder, etc.

defects.label: 2D→3D composition not preserved
defects.prevention: Keep the EXACT same composition, camera angle, framing, poses, gestures, expressions and background staging as the source panel — no recomposition.

defects.label: Fourth-wall gaze (looks at camera)
defects.scanner_line: FOURTH-WALL GAZE — a character makes eye contact with the camera on a beat that is not a scripted POV/direct-address beat.
defects.prevention: Characters look at each other or at the scene's focal object, never into the camera, unless the beat is scripted as direct address.

defects.label: Key body region cropped out of frame
defects.scanner_line: PAYLOAD CROPPED — the beat's declared key body region (waist, bust, bicep...) is cut off by the frame edge even though camera distance is otherwise correct.
defects.prevention: Frame the declared key body region fully inside the panel; adjust camera height/crop so it is never cut by the frame edge.

defects.label: 2D/illustration drift (should be 3D CGI)
defects.scanner_line: 2D / ILLUSTRATION DRIFT — the panel renders as flat 2D comic-book illustration, anime, or cartoon-shaded art instead of photoreal 3D CGI. (Flat 2D speech balloons / captions / SFX overlays are CORRECT and expected — judge only the bodies, skin, costumes and environment.)
defects.prevention: Photoreal DAZ3D CGI on the bodies, costumes, skin, hair, environment and lighting; NOT a 2D illustration on the bodies, NOT cartoon-shaded skin. Only the bubble / caption / SFX graphics are flat 2D comic-book overlay.

defects.label: VFX too perfect / AI-grade effects
defects.scanner_line: VFX TOO PERFECT — energy or VFX effects look simulation-grade (volumetric god-rays, physically-accurate filaments) instead of hand-made comic-book effects.

defects.label: State regression (progress resets)
defects.prevention: All accumulated state from prior panels — damage, size, hair, effects — carries forward IDENTICALLY; only this panel's declared change is new.
